title: Classic Eggs Benedict
desc: Perfectly poached eggs on toasted muffins with velvety hollandaise sauce.
steps: Bring a pot of water to a gentle simmer, add 1 tbsp vinegar.
Make hollandaise: whisk yolks and lemon juice in a double boiler until pale and thick.
Slowly drizzle in melted butter whisking constantly. Season and keep warm.
Toast muffin halves and warm the bacon slices in a pan.
Crack each egg into a small cup, swirl the water, and slide the egg in. Poach 3 minutes.
Assemble: muffin, bacon, poached egg, then drizzle hollandaise generously. Garnish with chives.

title: Avocado & Quinoa Buddha Bowl
desc: A nourishing vegan bowl packed with protein-rich quinoa and creamy avocado.
steps: Cook quinoa in vegetable broth for 15 minutes until fluffy. Fluff with a fork and let cool slightly.
Whisk together tahini, lemon juice, garlic, and 2 tbsp water to make dressing. Season to taste.
Arrange spinach as the base of your bowl.
Add quinoa, then arrange avocado, tomatoes, cucumber, and red onion in sections.
Drizzle dressing generously over everything. Serve immediately.
creator: 6a1d475caf444cb8cf81a6e9

title: Tiramisu Classico
desc: The authentic Italian dessert — espresso-soaked ladyfingers and mascarpone cream.
steps: Beat egg yolks with sugar until pale and doubled in volume (about 5 minutes).
Fold mascarpone into the yolk mixture until smooth.
Whisk egg whites to stiff peaks in a separate bowl.
Gently fold whites into the mascarpone mixture in thirds.
Mix espresso and liqueur. Briefly dip each ladyfinger (1–2 seconds per side) and lay in a dish.
Spread half the cream over the biscuit layer. Repeat with remaining biscuits and cream.
Dust generously with cocoa powder. Refrigerate at least 4 hours (overnight is best).
creator: 6a1d475caf444cb8cf81a6e9

title: Cacio e Pepe
desc: Rome's most iconic pasta — only three ingredients, but technique is everything.
steps: Bring a large pot of lightly salted water to boil. Cook pasta 2 minutes less than package says.
Toast black pepper in a dry pan for 60 seconds. Add ½ cup pasta water and reduce by half.
Reserve 2 cups pasta water before draining.
Add pasta to the pepper pan, toss over medium heat, adding pasta water a splash at a time.
Remove from heat. Mix cheeses with ½ cup pasta water to form a paste.
Add cheese paste off-heat, tossing vigorously until silky and creamy. Serve immediately.
creator: 6a1d475caf444cb8cf81a6e9

title: French Onion Soup
desc: Slow-caramelized onions in a rich beef broth, topped with melted Gruyère croutons.
steps: Melt butter and oil in a wide heavy pot over medium-low heat.
Add onions, salt, and thyme. Cook uncovered, stirring every 10 minutes, for 60–75 minutes until deeply golden.
Add sugar and wine; let the wine evaporate completely.
Pour in stock, bring to a simmer, cook 20 minutes. Season generously.
Ladle soup into oven-safe bowls. Top each with a bread slice and heap of Gruyère.
Broil 3–4 minutes until cheese is bubbling and golden. Serve immediately.
creator: 6a1d475caf444cb8cf81a6e9

title: Niçoise Salad
desc: A classic Provençal salad with tuna, olives, eggs and a Dijon vinaigrette.
ingredients: 2 cans quality tuna in olive oil
steps: Make dressing: whisk together olive oil, vinegar, mustard, salt and pepper.
Arrange salad leaves on a large platter.
Artfully place tuna (broken into large chunks), eggs, beans, tomatoes, olives, and onion.
Drizzle dressing generously over the salad.
Serve immediately with crusty bread.
